Volume II · Technical Dispatches

Field Notes & Engineering Treatises

Essays, mathematical models, firmware calibrations, and fabrication reflections from the machine shop and arena pits.

Engineering documentation should not be confined to bullet points on a resume. The following treatises document practical engineering investigations: solving motor cogging on high-inertia kinetic bars, deriving kinematics for microspine surface anchoring, mass elimination strategies at VEX Worlds, and the metallurgy of surviving 12,000-Newton impact shockwaves.

An analytical study of commutation timing, sinusoidal startup, PWM frequencies, and current-limiting tradeoffs when accelerating heavy steel flywheels under extreme current draw.
